verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pandoc's source is available: there is a public GitHub repository (github.com/jgm/pandoc), the install docs cover compiling pandoc yourself with build flags, and users file bug reports on GitHub. However, no item in the pack names the license or confirms it is open. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an open-source license, and a first-party statement about source access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: It is possible to compile pandoc such that the data files pandoc uses are embedded in the binary.
server: compile in support for running in HTTP server mode when the executable is renamed (or symlinked as) pandoc-server.
If you find a bug, the maintainer will fix it within hours of your GitHub report.
